title: build validate lists the files of every layer, repo first, and marks a file that a nearer layer shadows; with an id it adds the shadowed copies
source: intended: docs/decisions.md (build validate: a tolerant check of every build of every layer, one line per file, problem lines, one summary line)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-13, build validate). Files are listed in layer order (the project, trusted parents, the user folder), by file name inside a layer. A file whose id a nearer file already has is still checked and listed, with ` (shadowed by <layer> <display path>)` after its line; it is not the build of that id. The user folder here holds a copy of haiku-explorer (shadowed by the project's) and a user-only build. With an id the command prints the winner first, then the files it shadows, and its summary counts the winner only.

stdout.regex:
(?m)^ok verifier repo jitso/builds/verifier\.yaml
ok haiku-explorer user ~/\.jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml \(shadowed by repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml\)
ok user-only user ~/\.jitso/builds/user-only\.yaml
checked 9 builds: 9 ok, 0 invalid$

(?m)^ok haiku-explorer repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml
ok haiku-explorer user ~/\.jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml \(shadowed by repo jitso/builds/haiku-explorer\.yaml\)
checked 1 builds: 1 ok, 0 invalid$
